title: Brightidea
description: Documented public innovation management platform (Brightidea, Inc.) for the Invention Genesis Engine capability area.
body:
Brightidea is a documented innovation management platform from Brightidea, Inc.. A long-running enterprise idea-management platform where employees submit, discuss, and vote on ideas, and managers route the best ones into development pipelines with stage-gate tracking.

How it works: It works by generating a pool of candidate ideas against the stated objective, scoring each on novelty and feasibility with a seeded evaluator, and ranking the pool so the strongest candidates surface first.

Documented uses of this capability area include corporate innovation programs, patent landscaping for R&D strategy, open-innovation challenges, and systematic inventive-problem-solving training.

title: Spigit (Planview IdeaPlace)
description: Documented public crowdsourced innovation system (Planview) for the Invention Genesis Engine capability area.
body:
Spigit (Planview IdeaPlace) is a documented crowdsourced innovation system from Planview. Crowdsourcing software that runs large-scale idea challenges; uses pairwise comparison and prediction-market style voting to surface the strongest proposals from thousands of submissions.

How it works: It works by collecting ranked ballots from a panel of voters and applying a Borda count, so broad support beats polarizing picks and the winning idea reflects the group's collective judgment.

Documented uses of this capability area include corporate innovation programs, patent landscaping for R&D strategy, open-innovation challenges, and systematic inventive-problem-solving training.
